guidetextdraw_609773.text: Additional information is needed to explain your 2020 federal income tax filing status. Before we can determine financial need, we need verification from the Internal Revenue   Service (IRS) that you (and your spouse) did not file a Federal Income Tax Return for 2020.   Incomplete documents will not be returned. guidetextdraw._value:
HOW AWARDS ARE MADE

The Office of Financial Aid is committed to a fair and equitable awarding policy. We award limited funding to students who demonstrate the highest financial need and who meet the March 2 priority application filing date. We rank all students who meet the priority filing deadline according to family contribution (lowest to highest) and award funds accordingly. If funding is available after we have awarded students who meet our awarding criteria, we may consider exceptions to the policy as described below.

EOP GRANT

If you are an EOP student and were not awarded EOP Grant, visit the EOP office and speak with your counselor to discuss a possible exception to the EOP award policy. If an exception is approved, the EOP Office will forward a memo to our office. We will award EOP grant and send you an e-mail notification indicating a change to your financial aid award.

FEDERAL SEOG GRANT (FSEOG) AND STATE UNIVERSITY GRANT (SUG)

We do not accept appeals for FSEOG and SUG. Beginning mid-September and monthly thereafter, we will evaluate our funding levels and, if additional funding is available for new awards, we will rank all eligible students by expected family contribution and application date. Other criteria may be used to ensure funds go to the neediest students. If you are awarded FSEOG or SUG, we will send you an e-mail notification indicating a change to your financial aid award.

FEDERAL WORK STUDY

If you are canceling or requesting a reduction of your accepted Federal Work-Study (FWS) award please note that all earnings will be confirmed by the FWS Coordinator and we will also be in communication with your FWS Employer regarding your request and employment. Federal regulations and California labor laws require that student employees must be paid for hours worked and this may result in a change in your request.

REDUCING FEDERAL DIRECT LOANS

You may not receive the total amount requested as a loan processing fee is deducted from each loan disbursement you receive. If you require a specific loan amount, please inquire with a financial aid staff member to determine the amount that should be requested.

ADJUSTMENTS TO EXISTING AWARDS

We accept “Award Adjustment Appeal” forms to request a decrease or other adjustments to an existing award. We will review your appeal and make appropriate adjustments according to federal and state regulations and funding availability. We will notify you by mail or e-mail, depending on the nature of the adjustment and the decision reached.
